newsitem.title: USA: Acquest forms unit as part of focus shift.
newsitem.headline: Acquest forms unit as part of focus shift.

text.p: LOS ANGELES, Dec. 18 (Reuter) Acquest Corp on Wednesday said it has formed a wholly-owned unit, Acquest Financial Group Inc, to further shift its focus to financial services.
The new unit may, subject to regulatory approvals, begin providing investment banking services in the future.
Acquest said its Softpoint Division is still in operation on a limited basis, and the company is currently examining its long-term prospects.
